comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: hmmmm can someone tell me whats the difference of placing an ornament here and placing an ornament in the small galleries? why is switching someone else's ornament with your ornament so expensive, and the price differs from 17m to 70+m? when an ornament is placed here, will it be automatically removed after a certain period of time?

comments.author: B!
comments.body:
By placing an ornament in the large gallery I think you get more cultural contribution points and the ornament stays,in theory, much longer. The thing is, players put ornaments and add an extra amount (like 40m).
If someone else wants to put their discovery/ornament they must pay that value (which decreases everyday) + the extra amount. So, this extra amount is like a defense to prevent other people from just taking your place.
The smaller galleries let you put the ornament for a week and no one can take it. I think you get less cultural contribution too...

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: ah i see thank you :).....but does anybody know how long the ornament will last when placed in the large gallery assuming nobody steals your place in it?

comments.body: ty! and my guess is that after 100 days one cannot get back the money they added as an extra amount, right?
